story: An early break of five riders set the tone for the race. Midway through the stage, two of the escapees were dropped, leaving Veistroffer, Marsman and Goszczurny out front. With 12 km to go, Veistroffer launched a decisive attack. His breakaway companions were unable to respond and had to let him go. The peloton closed in late but ultimately failed to bridge the gap, allowing Veistroffer to take a well-deserved solo victory after spending the entire race on the attack. Behind the winner, Mulubrhan and Gruel sprinted to second and third place. With this victory, Veistroffer also moves into the overall lead.
